Seychelles — TVA à l'importation : extraits verbatim (relevés le 2026-10-05)

1. Seychelles Revenue Commission, « Value Added Tax (VAT) on Importation », brochure d'information (PDF du 24/11/2022,
   https://src.gov.sc/wp-content/uploads/2022/12/VAT-on-Importation-Brochure.pdf, sha256 e70812e6e665618c70cf1313929a46ffcdff006faeca9d7093e803fe3fa6b159) :
   « A VAT rate of 15% must be paid at the point of entry at the time of import on all imported goods. It applies to all methods of importation including by air, sea and post. »
   « VAT on imported goods is applied on the value of the import which is the CIF (Cost, Insurance & Freight) value plus import duty and excise (where applicable). NB: Levy is not included in the calculation of VAT at importation. »
   « However, there are some exceptions as specified under Schedule 1 (parts 1 and 2) of the Value Added Tax Act 2010, which exempts certain goods, class and category of persons from VAT. »

2. Seychelles Revenue Commission, page « Tax System » (https://src.gov.sc/seychelles-tax-system/, relevée le 2026-10-05, sha256 HTML 368ecdf1748f631ed8027d69b1ce4b6f9b9796951306b7df821a37bad70ae157) :
   « The 15% standard rate applied on most imported goods or services sold in Seychelles.‎ The zero rated (0%) applied on exports »
   « All goods imported into the Seychelles are treated as a taxable transaction under the VAT Act 2010 regardless of the status of the importer, (if the importer is VAT registered or not) or the nature of the transaction (commercial or personal importation). VAT o »
